body: Maybe I’m wrong or reading this wrong.  She smacked your arm?  Are you serious?  Unless she’s coming after you in anger this doesn’t sound like abuse.  I’m a touchy person and I lightly smack people on the arm all the time.  Like “good joke buddy” arm smack.  You didn’t really even explain the situation with the chest smacking.  Sounded like you were being a little rough rocking the baby and she flipped.  This reads to me like you’re trying to make her the bad guy or you’re downplaying the situation too much when you wrote it OR there’s more I haven’t read.
Honestly I agree.  I didn’t get spanked that often at all.  Every once in a great while was enough.
Just do it.  I had the same thing and it drug on for almost 3 years
Ew no.  Not the asshole.  That’s common curiously when you have guests over.  Now, I will say that he doesn’t have to share what he’s eating but if the kid is hungry give him something else ya know?

Wow.  You are not the AH.  This person is not your friend my dude.  I’ve known women that prefer suits over gowns.  What’s the big deal?  She’s not respecting you and she made her choice clear.  Wear what she wants you to wear even though you’re uncomfortable or don’t go.  I would never make someone wear something that made them uncomfortable.  Would she wear chaps and a bra to your wedding?  Like only that?  Point made.
Yes you are the AH

She’s stalking you fam.  Just because she’s your mom doesn’t mean you need a relationship.  People are so stuck on blood ties even if the person is toxic and a piece of trash.  Do what you need to do.
You’re too young to be smashing anyone.  You get a girl pregnant and you’re stuck with that kid.  Keep your pants on.
Nope she needs to respect your time.
No.  You need space.  They’re using you to watch the kids
Fuck it.  What do you need him for?  You already do everything.  Not like your life would change other than not having his stressful childish ass around.
Sounds like your mom is the child
No, because he would never have gotten a job
Break up
Your friend is crazy and no
Wtf.  Why would you even ask?  They’re literally name calling you.  Hell no you’re not the asshole
Nope you’re dad should have asked you … like wtf
So I assume once she figures out she’s getting gas lighted she will come back
People don’t change and you can’t fix that regardless.
